overall_summary: The performance data is extremely small (3 videos with negligible views), making it impossible to identify definitive winning patterns. The strategy must rely on low-sample exploration while testing high-relatability emotional hooks related to modern relationship grief.

weak_patterns.action: Use strictly Devanagari script for titles and captions to resonate deeply with the core Hindi emotional audience.
